articles.title: Russia outlines new digital depository rules ahead of fall crypto framework roll-out
articles.snippet: The central bank's draft rules require digital asset platforms to hold up to $2.8 million in liquid capital as a sweeping regulatory framework looms.

articles.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid is capitalizing on the volume and depth of its order book by giving firms the option to compose with the platform’s shared liquidity, rather than fragmenting it.

articles.title: Core Scientific lands AMD AI deal as bitcoin mining operation winds down
articles.snippet: The agreement accelerates Core Scientific’s pivot from bitcoin mining toward AI data centers, following the termination of its ASIC agreement with Block.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops as South Korean stocks tumble, Senate shelves crypto Clarity Act
articles.snippet: BTC shed 2% as South Korea's Kospi plunged 11% and the U.S. Senate shelved the Clarity Act, leaving the market facing a pivotal Fed decision on Wednesday.

articles.title: 1inch opens Aqua liquidity protocol across 13 chains
articles.snippet: Liquidity providers can keep assets in their own wallets, using one balance to back multiple positions without splitting capital across different pools.
